content.en: The **IBRD** was established in 1944 to assist in the reconstruction of post-war Europe. Today, it focuses on **poverty reduction** and **sustainable development** in middle-income and creditworthy low-income countries. It operates by providing loans, guarantees, and risk management products to member governments.

definition.en: Unlike the IDA, the IBRD lends to countries that have the capacity to repay loans.

content.en: The IBRD is one of the five institutions that constitute the World Bank Group.

content.en: Students often confuse IBRD with the IMF; remember that IBRD focuses on long-term development, while IMF focuses on balance of payments stability.
